class.name: MaszynaHeightmapTerrainLook
class.brief_description: What a heightmap terrain is drawn with.
class.description: The shader of a heightmap terrain and the textures of every layer of its palette in three arrays, made of the materials of the palette ([code]MaszynaHeightmapTerrainLooks[/code]), and what the shader needs of each layer.

members.member: The diffuse texture of each layer of the palette, by its index.
The normal map of each layer of the palette, by its index; flat for a layer without one.

What each layer of the palette is, [constant PALETTE_FLOATS] a layer: its index in the arrays, 1 / metres its textures repeat at, whether it has a normal map and a specular/gloss map, its reflection, the cosine and the sine of the angle its textures are turned by, its glossiness.
The shader of the terrain's clipmap rings.
The specular/gloss map of each layer of the palette, by its index.

constants.constant: The floats of a layer in [member palette].
